name: CommandPalette
title: Components/Navigation/CommandPalette
description: Reach workspace actions through one searchable keyboard surface.
purpose: Reach workspace actions through one searchable keyboard surface.
usage: Actions carry labels, groups, keywords, and callbacks. A controlled open state supports an explicit launcher alongside the optional shortcut.

css.value:
background var(--motion-fast),
    box-shadow var(--motion-fast),
    transform var(--motion-fast)

0 3px 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-scrim) 40%, transparent),
    0 20px 64px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-scrim) 55%, transparent)
